# 139.00 CAD reaching the CAD bank, parked against the CAD account,
# against a USD invoice.
#
# The settlement genuinely converts here: the receivable is USD and the money
# arrived in CAD. That makes it the opposite of the Q-039 case — there the
# invoice, the receivable and the bank were all USD and only the discarded
# split was CAD.
#
# No test reached this shape while the code was being written, and it is the
# one that fails worst: nothing about the entry is USD, so restating the parked
# split from what the bank received wrote 139.00 CAD onto the receivable as
# 139.00 USD and requoted the transaction USD — a rate of 1:1 that nobody
# stated, on an invoice that then read over-settled with no figure disagreeing.
#
# What this fixture produces: a CAD transaction of two CAD splits, in no lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-03-01 * "Money in, to the CAD bank"

	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 139.00 CAD
		guid: "e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9001122334"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Due From Director -139.00 CAD
